name: What's involved in your door repair process?

mainEntity.name: What's involved in your door repair process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our door repair process typically begins with an on-site assessment to diagnose the problem and determine the best solution. We then provide a detailed estimate for the necessary repairs, including parts and labor. Once approved, our skilled technicians proceed with the repair, using quality materials and established techniques to ensure a lasting fix. We conclude with a final inspection to confirm the door operates correctly and meets your expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves on-site assessment, a detailed estimate, professional repair using quality materials, and a final inspection to ensure proper operation.
